findings.message: Fixed FileAccess.remove_file() compilation error - Godot 4.6 does not have this method on FileAccess. Changed to DirAccess.remove_absolute() which is the correct API.
Added setup() method for method chaining pattern, compatible with InMemorySessionProgressStore and other adapters.
Updated JSON serialization from instance method to static JSON.stringify() - Godot 4.6 deprecated print_indent property on JSON instances.
Fixed directory listing for Godot 4.6 - changed from get_next_filename() to get_next() pattern with list_dir_begin()/list_dir_end().
Changed ProgressState typed arrays (Array[String]) to untyped arrays to avoid Godot 4.6 RefCounted typed array assignment issues. Added duplicate(true) for deep copies during deserialization.
Fixed score deserialization to handle int/float conversion from JSON.parse() which may return floats for integer values.
Updated main.gd to use FilesystemSessionProgressStore instead of InMemorySessionProgressStore for persistent storage.
Added duplicate(true) when deserializing dictionaries and arrays to ensure deep copies and avoid reference sharing.

summary: VS-026 implementation complete and ready for claude cross-review. All compilation errors fixed, tests pass, and all acceptance criteria met. FilesystemSessionProgressStore correctly saves/loads ProgressState. SandboxState wiring complete: PlayShell auto-loads sandbox on startup, saves on session end, and passes sandbox state to GameplayRuntime for restoration. GameplayRuntime has get_sandbox_state() and restore_sandbox_state() methods. New Game action fully implemented with confirmation dialog via NewGameButton in play_shell.tscn.
